trust_items_quoted: TRUST | MovieLens | Real rating counts and distributions; the misranking test stays simulated on top
Centre the LCB prior on the catalogue mean. Report per noise level, since D changes sign. 20 seeds. Use the measured SD.

real_data.role: calibration only; no second test; the misranking test stays simulated
real_data.licence: research use; no redistribution without permission; no commercial use; acknowledge and cite Harper and Konstan 2015; no endorsement

amendments_applied.R2-DATA: MovieLens calibration of NegBin dispersion (1 -> 0.4909) and base quality (Beta(4, 2) -> Beta(4.2726, 3.1944)) in every confirmatory config (protocol 13.1, 13.3)
amendments_applied.A-1: LCB prior centred on the catalogue mean: alpha_k = 5 * p_k (catalogue star shares), uniform fallback when no rating; replaces the uncentred arm (protocol 13.2)
amendments_applied.A-2: D_sigma per noise level reported with two-sided 95% stratified bootstrap intervals next to Dbar; descriptive, outside the Holm family; primary H1 unchanged (protocol 13.2; trust.analysis.pooled_by_level)
amendments_applied.A-3: 20 seeds per cell kept in every confirmatory config
amendments_applied.A-4: measured per-seed SD 0.0064 to 0.0128 replaces the 0.05 planning value; not re-measured under the calibrated generator (disclosed)
amendments_applied.not_applied: D-008 A6 (calibration-metric wording) is not in the approved list; D-008 A2 and A3 were measurements, not changes
amendments_applied.where: research/protocol.md section 13 (and inline notes in sections 2, 3, 4, 6, 8); EXP-001, EXP-002, EXP-003 status lines

common_decisions.C1: Data: real data as approved, synthetic otherwise. TRUST: MovieLens 1M calibrates the simulation's review-count dispersion and quality distribution; all confirmatory evidence remains simulated.
common_decisions.C2: PDFs: built with pandoc and Typst (-V mainfont="Libertinus Serif"); no LaTeX on the machine.
common_decisions.C3: Authorship: "Mohamed Bechir Kefi", no affiliation. The AI is disclosed as a research and development assistant, not as an author.
common_decisions.C4: Disclosure: exploratory values of the primary contrast D = tau_b(SHRINK_5) - tau_b(MEAN) were seen before the freeze, under the planning generator (Beta(4, 2), dispersion 1) and the uncentred LCB, in seed namespaces disjoint from the confirmatory ones (smoke exp_number 0 at N = 50; pilots 901 and 902). Values below. They motivated A-2 (sign change by sigma), A-1 (LCB far below MEAN) and A-4. They are not evidence for any hypothesis. The calibration fit computed no contrast.
common_decisions.C4_note: While checking that the code change kept exploratory outputs reproducible, the smoke and EXP-001 corner pilots were rerun into a scratch directory outside the repository; results.json was byte-identical (SHA-256 8fe78903... and 52815070...), so no new value was seen.
